name: Getsuyoubi no Pan to Gyuunyuu
source:
Monday morning looks painful after night's hangover. But the voice of Katsuragi-san is so inspirational that for a moment the headache disappears...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
宿醉后的星期一早晨令人痛苦不堪。不过，葛城的声音十分振奋人心，让头痛一时间都消失了…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
